values.title: Honesty, transparency, and results you can anticipate.
body: We guide residential and commercial clients through a structured path: brief, survey, planning, and a full design package with visuals you can trust.
Whether you are buying new property or refreshing an existing home, we help you see the full potential of the space — without noise or ornament for its own sake.

editorial1.title: From measured drawings to VR walkthroughs.
body: Our design projects include demolition and construction plans, reflected ceiling plans, electrical layouts, and full wall elevations with detailing you can build from.
Rendered stills, working video walkthroughs, and presentation films help you feel the space long before installation begins.

editorial2.title: Author supervision and turnkey fit-out — when you want continuity.
body: We collaborate with trusted partners for turnkey delivery, and we can stay on site with author supervision billed hourly so intent is preserved in every joint and finish.
Product design covers built-in and freestanding furniture — conceived to fit your architecture, not the catalogue.

about.title: About the studio
paragraphs: My name is Inna Yefimenko, and I am the founder of InnaYa Design Studio.
For more than 17 years, I have been creating interiors for apartments, private homes, and commercial spaces for clients from Ukraine, Moldova, European countries, and other regions around the world.

For me, interior design is not only about aesthetics. It is precision, logic, and attention to detail at every stage of the work. That is why thorough site surveys, thoughtful space planning, and deep project development before implementation form the foundation of my practice.

One of the studio's strengths is the ability to handle comprehensive project procurement. Through collaboration with representatives of leading European furniture manufacturers, I help clients select furniture, finishes, lighting, and interior objects while preserving the integrity of the concept and saving their time.
My approach is based on the belief that a good interior reflects the owner's way of life, remains relevant for many years, and makes everyday life more comfortable.
InnaYa Design Studio combines experience, modern technology, and attentive care for every detail that shapes a space for living.

services.title: Technologies
services.revitTitle: Our secret to flawless precision: why we design in Revit
services.revitImageAlt: Revit 3D architectural rendering of a modern residential house
services.vrImageAlt: Client using VR to preview a furnished interior in an empty space
revitIntro: When you entrust us with creating your interior, you receive not just beautiful images, but a maximally accurate digital model of your future space. We have moved away from outdated flat drafting in favor of advanced BIM technology (Building Information Modeling) using Autodesk Revit.
For you as a client, this means a guarantee of staying within budget, fewer builder errors, and saved time.
services.revitBenefitsTitle: Top 4 advantages of BIM design for your interior

revitBenefits.title: 100% protection from drawing errors
revitBenefits.body: In traditional programs, drawings are created separately from one another. If a designer moves a socket or wall on one plan, they may forget to update the wall elevation. In Revit, that is impossible. We work with a single 3D model: any change in one place automatically updates all plans, sections, and schemes. Builders receive perfectly coordinated documentation.

revitBenefits.title: Ideally accurate estimates without overpaying
revitBenefits.body: Forget buying tile or parquet "by eye." Revit instantly and accurately reads areas, volumes, and item counts directly from the project. You receive an honest and transparent bill of materials and furniture, where every square centimetre is accounted for. No sudden extra costs for additional materials during renovation.

revitBenefits.title: Volumetric planning instead of flat schemes
revitBenefits.body: You no longer need to imagine from a flat drawing whether a cabinet will fit or whether a wardrobe door will open comfortably. Designing in Revit, we see the interior in volume from the start. This allows us to perfect ergonomics, lighting scenarios, and spatial details before construction begins.

revitBenefits.title: Full control of engineering communications
revitBenefits.body: An interior is not only décor, but also ventilation, air conditioning, pipes, and hidden access panels. Revit allows design solutions and engineering networks to be combined in one model. We immediately see if a pipe "crosses" a built-in cabinet and fix it on screen, not on the construction site.

vrIntro: With VR technology, you can literally step inside your future home or apartment before renovation work begins. By putting on a virtual reality headset, you can freely explore every room, assess the layout, ceiling height, furniture placement, lighting, and decorative elements.

vrBenefits.title: A real sense of space
vrBenefits.body: On ordinary images, it can be difficult to understand the true size of rooms and the proportions of objects. In virtual reality, the interior is perceived at natural scale, which helps you make more considered decisions and avoid unpleasant surprises after the project is built.

vrBenefits.title: The ability to make changes in advance
vrBenefits.body: During a virtual walkthrough, many details become more noticeable: furniture placement, ease of circulation, combinations of materials and colours. This allows the project to be adjusted in time and an ideal result to be achieved before renovation begins, saving time and budget.

vrBenefits.title: Confidence in every decision
vrBenefits.body: A VR presentation helps you better understand the future interior and feel its atmosphere. You make decisions not from drawings and separate images, but based on a full experience of being in the space.

vrBenefits.title: A modern approach to design
vrBenefits.body: Using virtual reality is a new standard of professional design that makes the process of creating an interior clearer, more comfortable, and more engaging for the client.

vrClosing: We create not just beautiful visualisations — we give you the opportunity to see and feel your future interior before its implementation begins.
services.leicaTitle: Precise surveys with the Leica DISTO X6 P2P Package
leicaIntro: A quality design project begins with accurate measurements. Any error at the survey stage can lead to inaccuracies in drawings, additional costs, and complications during renovation. That is why we use the professional Leica DISTO X6 P2P Package measurement system — one of the most advanced solutions for high-precision surveys of apartments, homes, and commercial spaces.

leicaBenefits.title: Maximum measurement accuracy
leicaBenefits.body: The Leica system allows measurements to be taken with high precision even in complex rooms with many corners, niches, projections, and non-standard structures. This ensures a correct digital model of the property and eliminates errors when developing the design project.

leicaBenefits.title: Fast completion of a full room plan
leicaBenefits.body: Point-to-Point (P2P) technology measures distances between any points in space without physically reaching each one. Surveys are completed significantly faster than with traditional methods, and the client receives a finished project in shorter timeframes.

leicaBenefits.title: An ideal foundation for design
leicaBenefits.body: All dimensions are recorded in digital format and used to create accurate room plans. This is especially important when designing built-in furniture, kitchens, wardrobe systems, engineering communications, and other elements where every centimetre matters.

leicaBenefits.title: Work with complex architecture
leicaBenefits.body: High ceilings, panoramic windows, staircases, attic spaces, columns, and other architectural features are easily captured with professional Leica equipment. We obtain complete and reliable information about the geometry of the property, which allows us to create projects of any complexity.

leicaBenefits.title: Fewer errors — lower costs
leicaBenefits.body: Accurate surveys help avoid rework, mismatches during furniture and equipment installation, and additional expenses during renovation. The more accurate the initial data, the more predictable the result of project implementation becomes.

leicaBenefits.title: A modern approach to interior design
leicaBenefits.body: Using the Leica DISTO X6 P2P Package is part of our professional approach to work. We invest in modern technology to guarantee clients maximum accuracy, quality of design, and confidence in the final result.

leicaClosing: Precise design begins with precise measurements. That is why every one of our projects is based on professional surveys carried out with advanced Leica measurement equipment.

services.pricingLead: Indicative design fees from €25 per square metre for survey, planning, and design packages; product design and supervision are quoted individually.
services.consultationBody: We offer online consultations and a complimentary initial conversation covering your goals, scope, and a preliminary estimate of our fees. There is no obligation to commission work afterward.
consultationPrepareItems: Property location, approximate size (m²), and whether the project is new build, renovation, or fit-out only
Any available floor plans, surveys, or photos — sketches and phone pictures are fine
Your target timeline and a realistic budget range for design (and fit-out, if known)
Rooms and functions you need, plus fixed constraints such as lease rules, listed status, or structural limits
Reference images or short notes on mood, materials, and what to avoid (optional but helpful)
Who will attend the call and make decisions on your side
consultationExpectItems: A focused 45–60 minute video call (or in person when we are in the same region)
A structured conversation about how you will use the space, priorities, and non-negotiables
An overview of our process, typical deliverables, and project phases
A preliminary fee indication based on scope and square metres — refined after survey and brief
Straightforward guidance on whether our services match your scale, timing, and location
Clear next steps if you choose to proceed, with no pressure to commit during the call
